observations.finding: Both detached cap photos support a continuous outer base with two ears; no documented OHC-side notch. Hidden back cavity, lip and seal seat remain unseen.

Bare head photo948269 supports a continuous machined oblong seat margin with two fixing ears; 948266/948267 show joining shoulders and cast surfaces near the OHC housing. They do not supply a measured seat plane or concealed section.

build_v2.py line61 constructs the large OHC housing by an almost constant YZ outline extruded over X≈.008..080m, apart from edge treatment. This is a working modelling assumption, not a documented constant physical cross-section.

The degree and direction of actual housing taper, seat normal, axial offset, cap back profile and their dimensions cannot be separated reliably from the uncalibrated photos. No projection-only argument qualifies the current crossings.
